events.title: Posidonia 2026
body: What an incredible week at Posidonia 2026. We had an amazing time meeting friends, clients, partners and maritime professionals from around the world.

Events like Posidonia remind us of the strength of our industry and the value of personal connections. Thank you to everyone who met with the Barbados Maritime Ship Registry team. We truly enjoyed the conversations, and look forward to working together in the future.
